ārañjita.p: [Ā+raji+ta] (ti) CL=8 (place) where should  pierce and scrape out.
a: အာရဉ္ဇိတ(တိ)

B:
ārañjita：ārañjita（ti）
အာရဉ္ဇိတ（တိ）
«ā+raji+ta»
[အာ+ရဇိ+တ]
C: ārañjita：[pp．of rañjayati] furrowed; slashed; scratched．（nt．） a scar．
P: Ārañjita，[in form = Sk．*ārañjita，ā + pp．of rañjayati，Caus．of rañj or raj，but in meaning different．Perhaps to rac （as *racita） to furnish with，prepare，or better still to be regarded as an idiomatic Pāli form of soundroot *rac （see āracayā°） mixed with rañj，of which we find another example in the double spelling of āracayā （& ārajayā） q．v．] furrowed，cut open，dug up，slashed，torn （perhaps also “beaten”） M．I，178 （hatthipadaṁ dantehi ārañjitaṁ an elephant-track bearing the marks of tusks，i．e．occasional slashes or furrows）．（Page 107）
K:
ārañjita：အာရဉ္ဇိတ（တိ）
[အာ+ရဇိ+တ]
ထိုး-ဖြတ်-ဖောက်ထွင်း-ခြစ်-အပ်သော （နေရာ）။
DOP: ārañjati pr. 3 sg. [ā 2 + rañjati 2 ], pierces, scores, marks ; Sadd 349, 5 (nāgo dantehi bhūmiṃ rañjati ~ati); — pp ārañjita , mfn. and n. , slashed or scored; a mark, a furrow ; M I 178, 28 (uccā ca dantehi ~āni; Ps II 199, 2 foll. : vaṭarukkhādīnaṃ khandhapadese pharasunā pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ viya dāṭhāhi chinnaṭṭhānaṃ); Ps II 217, 22 (tathāgatārañjitan ti tathāgatassa ñāṇadāṭhāya ~-ṭṭhānaṃ) ≠ Nett-a 214, 9 (-ñāṇadantehi ~aṃ) quoted Sadd 349, 9 ; — ifc see tathāgat’-; — see also ārajayārajayā.
CPD: ārañjita , ( mf ) n., what is pierced, slashed, scrat- ched; nom. sg. mahāvajirañāṇa-sabbaññutañāṇa-dan- tehi rañjitaṃ ~aṃ, Nett-a 214, 9 ( C e 51, 31 ) ad Nett 10, 5 'Tathāgatarañjitaṃ', quoted Sadd 349, 9 ; nom. pl. uccā dantehi ~āni, M l 178, 28 , 34 ( expl. sattaṭṭhara- tanubbedhe vaṭarukkhâdīnaṃ khandhapadese pha- rasunā pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ viya dāṭhāhi chinnaṭṭhānaṃ, Ps ll 199, 1-3 ); see Hendriksen, Syntax p. 17/18; — ifc. v. Tathāgatâ ° (M l 181, 30 foll. ); — — ° -ṭṭhāna , n.; Tathāgatassa ñāṇadāṭhāya ~aṃ, Ps ll 217, 22 .
NCP: pp mfn. & neuter | aara~njita slashed or scored; a mark, a furrow.
